title: Just found this sub
content: Holy crap this makes the dreams even weirder!! Why do we all dream the same things?? Is there some sort of DreamHQ we're going to? I'm convinced it's a real place at this point. I realized I have built my own dream world a few years ago. It's definitely an accumulation of different places I've lived or visited. But the thing that gets me the most about the shopping mall is I always go to the same store! End up lookin through the same shelves in the same corner. My friends who barely seem to begin with think I'm crazy, so I'm glad to have found my people! One pic posted here that got me the most was the freeways. Why are they all tangled like that?? Anyway, happy to be here lol
